name: Proto-Chadic (family node)
notes: STRUCTURAL ANCESTRY NODE (not a modelled G2P target). Proto-Chadic is the reconstructed ancestor of the Chadic branch of Afroasiatic, the largest member of which is Hausa. It exists so that the ancestry and phylogenetic-distance metrics of the modern varieties that reference it have a node to resolve to. It carries no grapheme table: the ancestry metrics use only its classification and its ancestor links. A grapheme table needs a cited reconstruction that states its notation and the sound value of each symbol.
